meta.title: Tiantan Minecraft Experiment Log
meta.systemIntro: Run tiantan_build_001 resolves workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png, writes generated files under workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001, and replays worker, tool, and verification events without exposing local machine paths.

stages.label: 02 Vision
stages.system: trellis_reconstruct -> obj2schematic -> schematic_export; outputs land in vision/ and blueprint/.

stages.label: 03 Plan
stages.system: planner reads placements.jsonl and writes plan/{west,east,locks,checkpoints}.json.

stages.label: 04 Build
stages.system: build pool streams west/east diffs; temporary blocks use tmp/* tags for deterministic cleanup.

stages.label: 05 Verify
stages.system: verify compares merged_state.json with placements.jsonl; package writes final/craft_tiantan_build_001.tar.zst.
